description: "Date and you die."An Air Force Academy where dating is forbidden. Lin Ching-ha, a fourth-year student who punishes cadets for dating, is a young, arrogant jerk famous for his hawk-like gaze. Then one day— "Let's get married in our next life, too." A mysterious dying wish falls like a bolt from the blue. To the young twenty-three-year-old me, who is to become his wife ten years later. "I won't kill you this time." Who on earth are you... ...? "... ... I've thought of nothing but you for too long, Lin Ching-ha. You were so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off you. At first sight, ever since. ... ... And then, watching you die by my hand... ?" Shut up. If you were going to act like this, just confess already, you crazy bastard.
